name: duopore-public-variant-combination-audit
description: Find gaps in a product's size and color choices before you prepare a listing.

interface.longDescription: Find gaps in a product's size and color choices before you prepare a listing. Enter the sizes and colors you expect, then share the pairs in your product list. See missing pairs, repeated pairs and options you did not expect. It checks the two lists you provide, with up to 200 product options and 400 expected pairs.
defaultPrompt: Find missing size and color pairs in my product list.
Do any of these product variants appear twice?

positive.prompt: Use Variant Combination Audit with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"sizes":["S","M"],"colors":["Black","White"],"variants":[{"sku":"01","size":"S","color":"Black"},{"sku":"02","size":"M","color":"White"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 variant issues across 4 expected combinations.","rows":[{"size":"S","color":"White","issue":"missing","skus":""},{"size":"M","color":"Black","issue":"missing","skus":""}],"warnings":["Two-axis completeness only; missing combinations may be intentional."]}
